referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory refers to the entire transport life cycle. For rail infrastructure, expenditures and environmental interventions due to construction, renewal and disposal of rail tracks have been allocated based on the Gross tonne kilometre performance (48165 Mio. Gtkm). Expenditures due to operation of the rail infrastructure, as well as land use have been allocated based on the yearly train kilometre performance (24985 Mio. tkm). For the operation of goods transportation average data by rail in France were used. The data has been determined top down, by combining the total yearly energy consumption and the yearly performance of goods transportation.; UUID: c5e2c89e-9472-376e-b7ef-ea37076bc94c
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory includes the actual energy consumption for an average goods train in France using electro and diesel energy. In addition the diesel consumption and emissions of shunting processes are accounted for as well as the production and maintenance of vehicles and railyway tracks.
referenceFunction.name: Transport, freight, rail

representativeness.extrapolations: For the determination of the train and rail track demand per tkm date of Switzerland was used and extrapolated with the tkm of FR
